Lead Dnite vs Pult. Use multiscale to DD once then outspeed EQ. Keep Gholdengo for Rotom/Pex, immune to status. Scarf Chomp revenge kills Pult if Dnite falls. Watch Mega Scizor/Metagross priority.

Plan: Opp Chomp likely outspeeds (169>149) and OHKOs Gholdengo with EQ. Preserve Gholdengo, sac boost. Go Scarf Chomp to take neutral EQ and revenge with Dragon Claw. Keep Gholdengo healthy to setup later vs Pex/Rotom. Watch Mega Scizor/Metagross priority.

decisions.thought: 54% MOVE: dragonclaw, 42% MOVE: earthquake, 3% SWITCH: metagross

Plan: Gholdengo can't switch into Mega Chomp EQ (super effective, OHKO). Stay with Scarf Chomp, deal max damage with Dragon Claw before fainting. Then Gholdengo can revenge weakened Mega Chomp with Make It Rain. Preserve nothing, must trade.
